uncited: - **Octant Reference:** A 64-bit integer encoding the octant identity.
**Filter Leaves:** Traverse all leaves of the AMR-KDTree.
**Identify Inner Octants:** For remaining leaves, identify 'inner' octants within non-boundary regions.
**Merge Octants:** Merge identified inner octants into dual cells.
**Set Vertex Values:** For merged dual cells, set vertex values to the cell values.
- **Isosurface Value:** The scalar threshold for extraction.
In the naïve approach, all leaves of the AMR-KDTree are traversed, ignoring those that do not contain the isovalue.
Performance gain is dependent on the ratio of inner to boundary octants.
- Use when extracting isosurfaces from large AMR datasets with significant internal regions (non-boundary areas) to reduce computational overhead.
- Not suitable if the dataset is dominated by level boundaries, as the optimization provides less benefit and adds complexity in handling boundary cases.
